rationale: Twelve four-digit year labels at 10 px on an 18 px pitch: adjacent labels collide (Arial digits are 5.6 px wide at 10 px, so each label is 22 px). The estimate (0.5 em per glyph = 20 px) also exceeds the pitch, so text.overlap must fire. Note the estimate under-reads digit-heavy labels by about 11 %, so a 21-22 px pitch would collide on screen yet pass.
